speaker: Doctor
text: I see you recently completed antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis; have you developed any new symptoms like chills, nausea, or changes in your urination habits since finishing the course? To better understand your current condition, please tell me how much your flank pain is affecting your daily activities.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; have you noticed any blood in your urine or pain when you urinate? Also, what specific antibiotic were you prescribed for the sinusitis?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The history of flank pain, fever, fatigue following antibiotic treatment for sinusitis, and the transition of symptoms despite treating the initial infection is highly suggestive of a urinary tract infection ascending to the kidneys, potentially complicated by antibiotic-associated issues or a superinfection. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, Complete Blood Count (CBC). REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound.
